Name: Bastion Lunchbox Fixes
Description: v1.0.6: three stable configurations, permanent staged-write sequencing for light Lunch Boxes + 0% skirts, DigitalKaizer-owned runtime/log identifiers, and optional Codex Module Bridge v1 compatibility. Requires Bingus Shared Loader.

Options.Name: Fix Configuration
Options.Description: Choose one configuration. All 3 Fixes is recommended.

SubOptions.Name: All 3 Fixes (Recommended)
SubOptions.Description: Lunch Boxes: 0% Main transfer + AV4; Side Skirts: 0% Main transfer.

SubOptions.Name: Light Lunch Boxes + Side Skirts 0% Main
SubOptions.Description: Lunch Boxes remain AV2 with 0% Main transfer; Side Skirts use 0% Main transfer. Uses the proven safe staged-write sequence internally.

SubOptions.Name: Light Lunch Boxes 0% Main Only
SubOptions.Description: Lunch Boxes remain AV2 with 0% Main transfer; Side Skirts remain vanilla.
